title: Wastewater Pumping Station: PLC & Controls Upgrade
scope: Five duty pumps cut over to a new PLC one at a time in a live plant. At least 4 of 5 pumps must stay online during every shutdown.
assume: Plant geometry is schematic: wet well, 5 dry-pit pump sets, discharge header, MCC/VFD room and control room.
Each shutdown follows the owner's 21-day and 3-day notice rule; lock-out puts the pump offline until the closed-loop test.
Counter: pumps online = existing, tested or in service. Minimum 4 of 5.
